title: Turkish Reflexive Verb Form (-in / -n)
summary: Expressing actions the subject does to itself.
explanation: Attach '-in/-ın/-un/-ün' (or '-n' after vowels) to verb stems to indicate reflexive actions (e.g., yıkandı = washed [him/her]self).

common_error_explanations.err_trref_1: Use reflexive suffixes when the subject acts upon itself.
